steps.content: (Scene: The Rust)

A massive withered tree looms over the Rust, its desiccated black branches spreading chaotically in every direction. Waves of thick contamination relentlessly batter against the isolation belt, held back by the FAC forces and Anti-Mania devices surrounding the area.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: The barrier was working! Deploy the drones and get all personnel behind the safety line. This Mania tree is hunting for living targets—it's trying to use us as nutrients!
Just then, a piercing alarm blares as a contaminated vine violently lashes out, slamming against the blue energy barrier.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: No way, it's become way more hostile than before. What's going on?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Because all the trapped hostages have returned.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I think this "wisteria" needs fresh nutrients to maintain its massive form...

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: What?! That'd be a disaster! We can't let it enter the city—we need to end this now. Chief! Give us the order! We must eliminate the contamination source immediately!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: MBCC forces are also in position, Chief. We await your orders.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief?!
A Mania vine lashes out toward you, but instead of dodging instinctively, you reach out your hand, and the vine strikes your palm with crushing force.
[Release the shackles]
You grip tighter, desperately trying to push deeper, squeezing your back way into that illusion—but an abyss of chaos blocks your path.
The red glow of the shackles vanishes into nothingness, followed by a violent backlash as Mania tears through your every nerve. After a brief struggle, an overwhelming force knocks you backwards.
Your body slams into an FAC soldier who catches you—he's clearly terrified by what just happened.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Chief, are you all right? What were you trying to—
That was an experiment you decided to make on a whim.

The rampaging Mania craves for prey, driving these wisteria vines to expand and attack humans. But deep within the contamination lies another will—one that surpasses Mania's insatiable hunger, steadfastly refusing all who try to enter.
After expelling all its captured "visitors," the entrance that once led to the fete has sealed itself completely.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: All combat units, prepare to counterattack. Suppress the target's expansion with everything you've got—we cannot allow the contamination to spread beyond the Rust.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: And... concentrate your fire on breaching the contaminated shell. We need to expose the Mania core inside.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...If a Sinner is really in there, then dealing with them is my responsibility.
